mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS episode_id, e.tenant_key AS tenant_key, e.app_id AS app_id, e.problem_key AS problem_key, e.error_signature AS error_signature, e.generation AS generation, e.session_opened_at AS session_opened_at, e.session_last_event_at AS session_last_event_at, e.repeat_count AS repeat_count, e.distinct_user_count AS distinct_user_count, e.distinct_device_count AS distinct_device_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_feedback_episode_member m WHERE m.episode_id = e.id AND m.membership_status = 'ACTIVE') AS cluster_member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_feedback_episode_member m JOIN t_feedback_content c ON c.source_id = m.source_id AND c.masking_status = 'PASS' AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.episode_id = e.id AND m.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.problem_type IN ('CRASH','NO_RESPONSE')) AS crash_anr_member_count, t.cluster_id AS cluster_id, cl.canonical_symptom AS canonical_symptom, (SELECT s.package_name FROM t_feedback_episode_member m JOIN t_feedback_source s ON s.id = m.source_id WHERE m.episode_id = e.id AND m.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.event_time, m.id LIMIT 1) AS package_name FROM t_feedback_episode e LEFT JOIN t_rca_agent_task t ON t.id = (SELECT MAX(t2.id) FROM t_rca_agent_task t2 WHERE t2.episode_id = e.id) LEFT JOIN t_cluster cl ON cl.id = t.cluster_id WHERE e.id = #{episodeId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.app_version FROM t_feedback_episode_member m JOIN t_feedback_source s ON s.id = m.source_id WHERE m.episode_id = #{episodeId} AND m.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.app_version IS NOT NULL AND s.app_version <> '' ORDER BY s.app_version
SELECT f.control_version FROM t_app_version_release_fact f WHERE f.package_name = #{packageName} AND f.release_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.released_at DESC LIMIT 1
